faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad is 30th September 2026. It is advisable to complete the application process well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Research Associate position, candidates must possess a postgraduate or Master's degree in fields such as Management, Law, Economics, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or any related discipline.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Research Associate position must be submitted online. You can find the direct application link in the 'Important Links' section of this article, or you can visit the official website of IIM Ahmedabad to fill out the application form.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates regarding fees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate role at IIM Ahmedabad typically involves an online or in-person interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the IIM Ahmedabad Research Associate recruitment can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad is a full-time job opportunity. This means that selected candidates will be expected to dedicate their full working hours to the role.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIM Ahmedabad provide any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age limits and any applicable age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed in the provided data. Candidates should refer to the official notification for specific details on age criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of this job opening?
faq.answer: The job opening for the Research Associate position is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Candidates applying should be willing to work at the IIM Ahmedabad campus.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications for the Research Associate position at IIM Ahmedabad must be submitted online only. Offline applications will not be considered. Ensure you use the online application portal before the last date.
